senses.gloss: m.(b. h.;Saf. of ירד) [run-off,] fugitive, escaped, remainder.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 72b:1">Yoma 72ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>בגדי השרד</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 35:19">Ex. XXXV, 19</cite>) <he>אלמלא … ש׳ ופליט</he> but for the garments of priesthood, there would not be left of Israel a remnant or a survivor.
Ḥull. 133ᵃ; Snh. 92ᵃ (ref. to Job XX, 26) אין ש׳ וכ׳ by sarid a scholar is meant (with ref. to Joel III, 5); Yalk. Job 907.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 35:2">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXV</cite> <he>עד שיבוא ש׳ מיעקב וכ׳</he> until a remnant of Jacob shall come and give to his (Esau’s), sons a dish of lentils in mourning and trouble &c.; a. e.—Pl. <he>שְׂרִידִים</he>.
<cite ref="Megillah 6a:2">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite> (in a eulogy) <he>אוהבי ש׳ יושבי וכ׳</he> ye lovers of the saved (the scholars, v. supra), dwellers of Rakkath, go forth &c.
